method.label: Bound the frequencies and attain the bound

annotationRationale: The definition of a unique mode bounds every other frequency by 9. A universal lower bound and a construction attaining it establish the minimum.
sourceMethod: Follows the official frequency bound and explicit construction, using division with remainder instead of ceiling notation.

review.mathCheck: With 224 distinct values, the list could contain at most 10+223·9=2017 entries. Thus at least 225 are needed. The proposed construction contains 2018 entries and has unique mode 224 with frequency 10, attaining 225 distinct values. Answer D is correct.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of official Solution 14, page 6: the same frequency bound and attaining construction, with integer division replacing ceiling notation.
review.annotationCheck: Both assessed concepts match the argument. The explanation establishes necessity and attainability without a material gap.
